title: List of Prophecies missions and primary quests
wikitext:
This is a list of all the [[mission]]s in [[Prophecies]], taking you through the [[storyline]], as well as some quests connecting the missions. Characters from non-Prophecies campaigns who travel to [[Tyria]] will join the storyline at [[Lion's Arch]], with the quest [[Report to the White Mantle]].

==Notes==   
* Unlike the other [[campaign]]s and [[Guild Wars Eye of the North|Eye of the North]], any Prophecies primary quest can be acquired without completing its preceding mission or primary quest. The only missions that cannot be skipped to finish the game are: Thunderhead Keep, Ring of Fire, Abaddon's Mouth and Hell's Precipice.  
** Access to the Crystal Desert is not required, and requires completion of Sanctum Cay.
** Access to The Dragon's Lair (and the [[Tomb of the Primeval Kings]]) is not required, and requires completion of Augury Rock which in turn requires completion of the other three Crystal Desert missions.
** Access to the Ring of Fire Islands and the last three missions is required, and requires completion of Thunderhead Keep.

== Trivia ==
* During early development, three mission maps existed which did not make it into the final game, called 'Shipwreaked', 'Hands of Dwayna', and 'Lost Treasures', as mentioned by an alpha tester in the Photics e-zine issue #10 from October 2004.<ref>https://photics.com/issues/issue10.pdf</ref>
